prompt:

Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is launching an aggressive city-wide crackdown to hunt down every single bin left out, and they’re prepared to hit everyone with massive, bankrupting fines starting immediately. You absolutely cannot leave your bin out for even a second past 8am unless you want to be targeted."
text: The council is officially launching a neighborhood-wide surveillance operation to hunt down every stray bin, and they’re prepared to hit us with massive, bankrupting fines starting immediately.
